cards.title: Probability of Target Attainment (PTA) Simulation Methodology
cards.claim: PTA is determined using simulations (typically Monte Carlo) based on POPPK models and nonclinical PDTs. Simulations estimate the probability of achieving the PDT at specific MIC values. Results should be presented by pathogen group and PDT level (stasis, 1-log, 2-log).
conditions: Simulations should use the same PK model from which parameter estimates were obtained.
Inputs include central tendency statistics and variance for PK parameters.
Adjustments for protein binding are required unless binding is low.
If only healthy volunteer data is available, variability must be inflated to reflect patient population.
limitations: PTA is a probability of achieving a microbiological target, not a probability of clinical cure.
Simulation validity depends on the accuracy of the POPPK model and PDT derivation.
cards.downstream_use: Supports dose regimen selection by demonstrating the likelihood of achieving efficacy targets across the MIC range.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
